aspects.evidence: As a commercial pilot, my roster is all over the place. Sometimes I'm gone for 4 days on an international rotation, sometimes I'm home on a Tuesday afternoon. I won't sugarcoat it, it's definitely hard on relationships.
aspects.statement: Vikram works extremely irregular hours and acknowledges the toll his flying schedule can take on personal relationships.

aspects.evidence: Because I travel so much, I need a partner who has her own active life, friends, and ambitions. If she expects us to have dinner together every single night, she's going to be miserable.
aspects.statement: He needs a highly independent partner who has a fulfilling life of her own and doesn't rely solely on him for daily companionship.

aspects.evidence: I work in close quarters with a mixed crew and stay in hotels worldwide. Absolute trust is non-negotiable for me. I can't deal with jealousy or constant check-ins asking who I am with.
aspects.statement: Vikram considers a lack of trust, jealousy, or clinginess to be absolute dealbreakers due to the nature of his job.

aspects.evidence: I'm literally off the grid for hours when flying. But the minute the wheels touch down and I get network, I'm the first one to call or text. I make up for the absence when I'm on the ground.
aspects.statement: He is unreachable while working but compensates by being highly communicative and present when he lands.

aspects.evidence: My job is literally travel, so on my days off in Mumbai, I crave a slow morning. Just a good pour-over coffee, no alarms, and maybe catching up on some reading.
aspects.statement: Vikram enjoys a balanced lifestyle, appreciating global exploration during layovers and quiet, restful days when back home.

aspects.evidence: Staying fit is part of the medical requirements, so you'll find me at the gym often. But my real passion is street photography. I always carry my mirrorless camera on layovers to capture the local vibe.
aspects.statement: He is passionate about fitness, which is required for his job, and street photography, which he practices during his travels.

aspects.evidence: Marriage has to be an equal partnership. If she is working a 9-to-5 and I have a Tuesday off, I'm obviously going to handle the groceries and cook dinner. It's just common sense.
aspects.statement: He views marriage as a strictly equal partnership and is ready to take on household responsibilities during his days off.

aspects.evidence: My folks are settled in Pune post-retirement. It's just them, me, and my younger sister who is currently studying abroad. They're pretty chill and don't interfere much.
aspects.statement: Vikram comes from a supportive, moderately modern nuclear family based in Pune.

aspects.evidence: I'm spiritual in my own way. I visit the Siddhivinayak temple when I can, but mostly I just try to be a decent human being on a daily basis rather than following strict rituals.
aspects.statement: He maintains a personal, low-key spiritual practice without being heavily ritualistic.

aspects.evidence: Mumbai is my home base for the airline. My seniority is tied to it, so I can't really move or relocate anywhere else for at least the next 5 to 7 years.
aspects.statement: He is firmly rooted in Mumbai for the foreseeable future due to his airline's base of operations.

aspects.evidence: I earn quite well and have made some solid investments, but I really respect a woman who understands financial planning. We should both have a clear understanding of our safety net and future goals.
aspects.statement: He earns a comfortable salary but strongly values financial literacy and planning in a relationship.

aspects.evidence: I am genuinely building my dream career. Just fair warning, crunch weeks mean I basically live on coffee and pizza for a bit, but I always make up for it after with plenty of downtime.
aspects.statement: Yash loves his job as a game developer, though he admits the hours can get intense during product launches.

aspects.evidence: Weekends are usually for D&D or co-op gaming with friends, but I do drag myself out for a trek in Nandi Hills once a month so I do not literally fuse with my couch.
aspects.statement: He enjoys a relaxed, slightly nerdy lifestyle centered around pop culture, but tries to balance it with outdoor activities.

aspects.evidence: A marriage is basically a two-player co-op game, right? We have to share the load. I do the cooking, though I admit I can be a bit messy in the kitchen while doing it.
aspects.statement: He strongly believes in equal partnership and sharing household responsibilities, even if he is not the most organized person.

aspects.evidence: Mom and dad are in Pune and they are super chill. We do weekly video calls, but they know my life and work are fully set up here in BLR.
aspects.statement: He is close to his parents in Pune but cherishes his independent life in Bangalore.

aspects.evidence: Honestly, Bangalore is the hub for gaming studios in India. Moving away is not an option for my career right now, so I really need someone who is happy to settle here.
aspects.statement: He is firmly tied to Bangalore due to his niche industry and has no plans to move.

aspects.evidence: I tend to crack jokes when things get too serious or heavy. I am working on being more direct with my feelings, but sarcasm and humor are definitely my default settings.
aspects.statement: He uses humor to navigate conversations and might need a little time to express deep emotions.

aspects.evidence: I watch a ton of YouTube cooking channels. Making a killer ramen broth from scratch takes me twelve hours on a Sunday, and I love every minute of the process.
aspects.statement: He is an adventurous home cook who loves trying out international cuisines on weekends.

aspects.evidence: I used to blow half my bonus on GPUs and gaming rigs, guilty as charged! But now I am seriously tracking my expenses and saving for a downpayment on a flat in HSR Layout.
aspects.statement: He earns well but admits to spending heavily on electronics, though he is now pivoting towards saving for real estate.

aspects.evidence: My biggest turn-off is someone who rolls their eyes at gaming or says 'aren't you too old for video games?'. It is my career, my art form, and my hobby all rolled into one.
aspects.statement: He cannot tolerate a partner who dismisses his passions as childish.

aspects.evidence: I would love a girl who has her own thing going on. We can be in the same room doing completely different things and just enjoy the companionable silence without feeling ignored.
aspects.statement: He seeks a partner who is passionate about her own career or hobbies and values independent downtime.

aspects.evidence: I will happily dress up in a kurta and sit for a Diwali puja because it makes my mom happy, but on a day-to-day basis, I do not really pray or follow fasts.
aspects.statement: He is culturally connected but personally agnostic.

bio_note: Yash is an enthusiastic and creative Game Developer based in Bangalore. He is passionate about his work but is actively trying to find a better work-life balance. He seeks a partner who understands his slightly nerdy side, values their own independence, and can enjoy companionable silence as well as adventurous weekend cooking.
brief: A realistic, likeable person with a mix of strengths and quirks — a plausible but imperfect match.
